text:
maya: Heads-up: launch handoff checklist needs final owners. Were missing a commit collector and a clear rollback trigger list. Can owners confirm SLA, docs, monitoring, pricing, and oncall?
sam: SLA draft is ready. Targets: 99.9% uptime, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 350ms for gen. SLA credits spreadsheet linked.
devin: p99 is aggressive on long-context cases. Plan to auto-fallback to slim-model at 420ms and emit a burn-rate alert at +10% over 1h. Ill own the alerts and runbook entries.
maya: Thanks @devin. Please add alert names and Slack escalation steps.
alex: Pricing: proposing Starter/Pro/Enterprise tiers. Starter = strict QPS + token caps; Pro = higher QPS + burst; Enterprise = reserved capacity + credits. Ill post finalized table by EOD.
liz: Docs owner here. Ill put up quickstart, SDK + curl snippets, and a short customer rollback FAQ. Will include a troubleshooting matrix for latency/noise. ETA: EOD.
sam: Oncall plan: primary + backup for the first 2 weeks then back to regular rotation. Need final roster names 24h before.
maya: Who signs day-of? Ops, Eng, Product, FinOps, Docs. Ill collect signatures via the launch signoff sheet.
alex: FinOps will sign after pricing table is final. Ill coordinate with finance.
devin: Rollout policy suggestion: micro-canary 1% first 3h, 5% next 12h, 25% after 48h. Auto-rollback if error rate > 2% sustained for 15m or latency SLO violated.
liz: Add a customer-facing "what to expect" note about cold starts and quantization artifacts; include a token limit playbook.
sam: Observability: token-cost dashboards, per-route latency heatmap, sampled traces, model-version diffs. Retain traces 30d.
maya: Need synthetic prompt set for quality regression detection tied to alerts. Who owns eval hooks?
devin: Eng-ML will own the synthetic set. Ill wire alerts to #eng-ml and #infra.
alex: Risk: reserved-capacity sizing. Sales must collect minimum commit numbers or we risk being underprovisioned. Who leads collection?
maya: Alex + Sales to own commit collection; product to publish minimums. Ill follow up with Sales lead.
sam: Smoke tests scheduled tonight; small chaos run tomorrow AM. Ill post results here.
liz: Draft docs link will be posted when ready.
maya: Final signoff checklist for T-12h: SLA doc, runbook, alert defs, smoke results, docs published, pricing table, oncall roster, and commit collector. Ill circulate the short signoff form.
ops-bot: Reminder set for 1711125934 (T-24h) to collect signatures.
devin: Smoke started, will update in ~25m.
sam: Thanks 44d
